benchmark_transforms: benchmark the throughput of SSL image transforms using single and multi-queue multiprocessing
test_blur_transform: test the ImgPilGaussianBlur transform throughput with configurable probability and radius range
test_color_distort_pil: test the ImgPilColorDistortion transform throughput with configurable strength on PIL images
test_multicrop_transform: test the ImgPilToMultiCrop transform throughput with multiple crop sizes and scales
run_benchmark_suite: run the full benchmark suite of SSL transforms and print processing speed in frames per second
